result.notes: Workbook title 'TARNWELL ENGINEERING LTD' matched to TW-UK02 Tarnwell Engineering Limited (not the Services company). Amounts are in GBP thousands and kept as-is. Source shows costs and tax as negatives, so cost of sales, distribution, administrative, finance costs and tax carry factor -1; 'Other operating income' is already signed (net expense) and keeps factor 1. Deferred tax asset sits inside debtors in the source and is moved to deferred tax assets, so the printed Total debtors and Total current assets are tied via formulas that add it back. Prepayments and other debtors go to other current assets; overdraft and current bank loans to current borrowings; accruals and other taxation/social security to other current liabilities; share capital and share premium are combined. Dividends come from the reserves note with factor -1. All printed totals and cross-statement checks tie, so no source exceptions.
